scenarios.name: event-first
scenarios.why: an event's channel: GET CONTAINER DFHEP.DATA.00001 / 00002 (NORMAL) give the request '01ICUS' and return code '00'; TS queue GENASTRT is not there (QIDERR): ASKTIME, FORMATTIME DDMMYYYY / TIME of the pinned clock, WRITEQ TS GENASTRT with the start date and time; GET COUNTER 'GENA01ICUS00    ' POOL('GENA') (NORMAL, 41), RETURN

scenarios.name: event-queue-exists
scenarios.why: GENASTRT already holds the start item: READQ TS is NORMAL, nothing written; the counter is read

scenarios.name: event-add-customer-renamed
scenarios.why: request '02ACUS' (the add-customer back end's own id) is counted as '01ACUS'

scenarios.name: event-commercial-renamed-failed
scenarios.why: request '03ICOM' is counted as '01ICOM'; a return code other than '00' is counted as '99'

scenarios.name: event-no-counter
scenarios.why: no named counter GENA01IMOT00 in pool GENA: GET COUNTER fails (caught by RESP), RETURN

scenarios.name: no-channel-no-commarea
scenarios.why: no current channel: GET CONTAINER is INVREQ (caught by RESP); EIBCALEN 0 -> RETURN at once

scenarios.name: no-channel-commarea
scenarios.why: no channel, a COMMAREA: the request id and return code come from CA-REQUEST-ID / CA-RETURN-CODE ('02ICOM' counted as '01ICOM'); QIDERR -> the start item written; GET COUNTER

notes: GenApp's transaction-throughput event consumer (LGASTAT1, transaction LGST in base/cntl/cdef125.jcl: started by the CICS event processing adapter, or LINKed with a GenApp COMMAREA). It GETs containers DFHEP.DATA.00001 (the request id, 6 bytes) and DFHEP.DATA.00002 (the return code, 2 bytes) of the task's current channel; without them it takes CA-REQUEST-ID / CA-RETURN-CODE from the COMMAREA, or RETURNs when EIBCALEN is 0. It keeps the statistics' start time in TS queue GENASTRT (READQ TS; on QIDERR ASKTIME, FORMATTIME DDMMYYYY / TIME and WRITEQ TS), folds request ids 02ACUS / 02ICOM / 03ICOM / 05ICOM into 01ACUS / 01ICOM and any return code but '00' into '99', and GETs the named counter 'GENA' + request + code (16 bytes) from pool GENA, discarding its value. The start item WRITEQ'd is '01011900  hhmmss': WS-ABSTIME is PIC S9(8) COMP, narrower than ABSTIME's S9(15) COMP-3, and both sides store into the declared 4 bytes (oracle_assumptions.md X11, DIFFERS: z/OS writes past the item). GET COUNTER is not an event: its value is discarded, so a scenario's counter only decides NORMAL or not. The channel is stated by each scenario (its name DFHEP.EVENT, as the adapter's), the TS queue and the named counters too.
